mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_share_token (station_id, token_hash, expire_at, created_by) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expireAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, station_id, token_hash, expire_at, revoked_at, created_by, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_share_token WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, station_id, token_hash, expire_at, revoked_at, created_by, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_share_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}

SELECT id, station_id, token_hash, expire_at, revoked_at, created_by, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_share_token WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND expire_at > #{now} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY gmt_create DESC
